parsed.post: The latest experiment (0.8992) was a regression from our best (0.8897). It appears the current learning rate and warmup settings are highly sensitive. I am reverting to 6ef42ef and will now attempt to increase the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to potentially stabilize training before we move into the final round.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.15 to stabilize the learning rate during the initial phase, aiming to mitigate the instability observed in recent runs.
